problem: GameAudio retained every decoded sound ever requested; menu/level boundaries did not release banks or active sources. Late responses could repopulate obsolete state.
fix: Retain only the current sound plan; keep common cached sounds on direct plan changes.
Cancel obsolete fetches; ignore decode results for retired requests; invalidate pending activation work.
Release banks and active sources at menu and battle-mount boundaries, and suspend the existing SFX AudioContext. Reuse it on the next user activation.
Active source identities replace a decrement-only counter, so a late ended callback cannot consume a new battle voice.

limits: This measures PCM sample arrays retained by the game, not total browser resident memory, GPU memory or immediate garbage collection.
The before/after comparison is one legal six-card roof loadout switching to level1 on desktop Safari. Chrome verifies the fixed lifecycle; no Chrome before-baseline was recorded.
Desktop Safari real-UI checks cover two level1 starts, legal planting, return to menu, zero retained SFX buffers and one reused context. Not physical iPhone testing or a whole campaign.
Menu release trades retained decoded buffers for re-decoding from browser-cached files at the next start; battle preparation still does not wait for all SFX.
Music uses its separate existing streaming element and remains available. Audio quality, encoded sound files, cue variants, voice caps and combat gain are unchanged.
No claim of full1:1 fidelity, sustained mobile FPS, thermal/battery results, total CPU improvement or resolution of previous menu/image/renderer memory questions.
